description.value: A white mage learns further talents to assist her in manipulating spells and other forms of magic. She may choose one of the following advanced mage talents in place of a mage talent. Talents marked with an asterisk add effects to a white mage's spellcasting ability. Only one of these talents can be applied to an individual spell and the decision must be made before the spell is cast. A complete list of advanced white mage talents can be found in the Advanced Mage Talents compendium.
